app.name: Jigyasa Talks
nav.none: No podcasts yet. Tap New podcast to start.
home.title: Turn your textbook into a podcast 🎧
home.lead: Add a chapter PDF and listen to two friendly voices explain it, in your language and at your class level.
home.drop_sub: PDF, a photo of the page, Word, PowerPoint or text. Drag it here or tap to choose.
err.server: The server cannot be reached. Start it again and reload this page.
err.keys: Some API keys are missing on the server: {keys}. Add them to .env and restart.
err.pdf_only: Please choose a PDF, a photo (JPG, PNG), a Word or PowerPoint file, or a text file.
sess.delete_confirm: Delete this podcast space with its PDFs and audio? This cannot be undone.
sess.drop_sub: PDF, a photo of the page, Word, PowerPoint or text. You can add more than one.
doc.ocr_route: Read with OCR and translated to English for the AI
doc.rereading: Reading {name} again in the selected language…
cmp.title: Create your podcast
cmp.ask_hint: For example, a focus, a tone or things to avoid. You can write in any language.
cmp.ask_ph: e.g. Focus on the causes, use real-life examples, keep the language simple
cmp.ask_ph_part: Name the topic, section or pages, e.g. "Only the part on stomata" or "Pages 4 to 6 of the second PDF"
cmp.via_note: Written and checked in English, then translated into {lang} by Bodhan.
cmp.subject: Subject
cmp.detail_ph: Describe the detail you want, e.g. focus on diagrams and definitions
cmp.basics_hint: Adds a short opening part on the ideas this material assumes you already know.
cmp.part_needs_text: Please name the topic, section or pages you want.
st.waiting: Waiting for the PDFs to be read…
st.writing: Writing, checking and recording: {ready} of {n} segments ready
ep.not_found: That topic was not found in your PDFs. Try naming the heading or the pages.
ep.stopped: This podcast could not be completed: {why}
ep.listen_now: Finished segments can be played already.
ws.no_page: This part explains background ideas, so there is no PDF page for it.
ws.single_segment: Playing segment {n} on its own. The full podcast, with music, is available once every segment is ready.
ws.wait_first: The player appears as soon as the first segment is ready.
seg.translated_hint: Hover over a line to see the checked English original.
seg.failed: This segment could not be created: {why}
seg.regen_failed: The last update failed: {why} The previous version is still in place.
seg.review_list: The reviewer compared the script with your PDF and could not settle these points. Please check them against the source:
seg.round_issues: {n} issue(s) sent back to the writer
seg.heard: The audio for this line may not match the text. The speech check heard: "{text}"
busy.queued: Waiting for a free slot (up to {n} segments are processed at once)
busy.manual_sub: Your edited lines are being turned into speech. Nothing else is changed.
busy.ai_sub: Writing, adapting for the listener, checking against the source, then recording.
edit.how: How would you like to change this segment?
edit.manual_note: The lines below are now editable. Change what you like, then tap Save at the bottom.
edit.ai_ph: e.g. Explain photosynthesis with a cooking analogy
edit.ai_need: Select a change or describe what you would like.
edit.ai_note: The agents rewrite this segment, check it against the source and record it again.
edit.ai_via: The agents revise the checked English script, check it against the source, then Bodhan translates it into {lang} and it is recorded again.
ws.music_both: Full podcast with intro and outro music. Press play to start from the beginning.
ws.music_intro: Full podcast with intro music (no outro file was found or it could not be read; see the activity log).
ws.music_outro: Full podcast with outro music (no intro file was found or it could not be read; see the activity log).
ws.music_none: Full podcast without music: see the activity log for the reason.
home.how1: Add your chapter: a PDF, a photo of the page, or Word / PowerPoint notes.
home.how2: Pick your class and the language you want to listen in.
home.how3: Tap Create podcast, then listen while the page follows along.
welcome.title: Welcome! Let's make your podcast 👋
welcome.lead: Start by adding what you want to learn from: a PDF, a photo of a textbook page, or your Word or PowerPoint notes.
welcome.tip: Tip: you can add more PDFs later, and make more than one podcast from them.
steps.label: Steps
doc.detected_q: We think this is written in {lang}. Is that right?
doc.detected_why: This helps us read it correctly. It is not the language of your podcast; you choose that below.
doc.which_lang: Which language is this PDF written in?
doc.reread_note: We will read the PDF again in that language.
cmp.lead: Pick two things and tap the button. Uses {n} PDF(s) added here.
cmp.more_hint: Optional: length, style, topic, level of detail
cmp.wait_pdf: Please wait until your PDF has been read.
nav.hide_side: Hide the sidebar for a bigger view
edit.mode_ai_desc: Say what to change. The AI rewrites it, checks the facts and records it again.
edit.mode_manual_desc: Change the words yourself. Only the audio is recorded again.
edit.ai_any_lang: You can write in any language.
seg.final_hint: The final check found a possible change in a number or fact after translation.
seg.final_line: Please check this line against the original: {text}
seg.removed: {n} line(s) removed because they could not be confirmed
seg.removed_why: After the reviews, these lines still could not be matched to your PDF, so they were taken out:
req.not_done: Your change could not be made
req.tip: Tip: the AI only uses facts from your PDF. Ask for something the PDF covers, or use "Edit it myself".
edit.mode_fresh_desc: Write this segment again from scratch, with no instructions.
edit.fresh_note: The agents write this segment again from the same part of your PDF, check it and record it. The current version is kept, so you can switch back.
